# Wolfie Jessner

> **Wandering Eye** des Neuf Yeux — tutor **Rural affairs + Empire's North** de Wolfgang. Originaire **Middenheim**. Cultiste Tzeentch caché. **Left Reikguard for Middenheim a month ago**. **Private diary leaked** : *« expresses concerns that some of his fellow tutors are worshippers of dark powers »* — Wolfie peut être **moins enthousiaste cultiste** que les autres.
